- added `r.identity-policies` (MUST): "TestTokenStore_IdentityPolicies asserts that a token created against an identity receives exactly the expected identity policies, and fails when identity_policies is set on a token that should not carry any."
- added `r.invalid-entity-id` (MUST): "TestTokenStore_TokenInvalidEntityID mounts the userpass credential backend and fails when a token whose backing entity is invalid is accepted instead of rejected with an error."
- added `r.orphan-response` (MUST): "TestTokenStore_CreateOrphanResponse creates an orphan token with the default policy and fails unless the returned secret's Auth.Orphan field is true."
- added `r.package-and-location` (MUST): "Both test files declare package token and live in the directory third_party/openbao/internal/vault/external_tests/token, forming one compiled Go test package of external tests."
- added `r.revocation-on-startup` (MUST): "TestTokenStore_RevocationOnStartup creates tokens and leases, restarts the core, unseals it, and fails unless the remaining lease count and token count match the expected leftovers after startup revocation."
- added `r.standby-invalidation` (MUST): "TestTokenStore_StandbyInvalidation creates a token, requires a non-empty client token, then uses require.EventuallyWithT to poll lookup-self and fails unless the reported ttl crosses the cutoff in the expected direction, and likewise for the renewable flag on the other token class."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-external-tests-userpass-binary

- intent: "" -> "This context exists to name and delimit the IP-token-binding external test of the userpass auth method, so that the spec records the file as part of the repository without inventing an API. It is a documentation anchor: the file is a test, it exports no interface, and everything it exercises is reached through helpers defined elsewhere. Keeping it as its own context stops the exported-interface description from being padded with symbols that the observed facts do not support."
- added `r.ip-token-binding-external-test-present` (MUST): "The repository must carry third_party/openbao/internal/vault/external_tests/userpass_binary/ip_token_binding_test.go as part of the userpass_binary external test set, so that the IP-token-binding behavior of the userpass auth method has a dedicated test file inside the vendored tree."
- added `r.no-exported-interface` (MUST): "The context must expose no exported interface: the observed facts list the file alone and no function, type, method, constant or variable, so other packages may depend on this path only as a test target and never import a symbol from it."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-external-tests-workflows

- intent: "" -> "The context exists to prove end-to-end that the workflows engine behaves correctly across the HTTP surface: storage and listing of workflow definitions, execution of multi-flow workflows that template paths and thread responses between flows, rejection of recursive workflows, authentication with MFA enforcement, permission gating of unauthenticated execution, and the internal-only nature of the alias-lookahead operation. It anchors those invariants to runnable acceptance tests so a change in the workflows subsystem that breaks any of these observable behaviours fails the suite."
- added `r.alias-lookahead-internal-only` (MUST): "A workflow whose authentication flow uses the alias-lookahead operation must exist and be listable, but executing it through sys/workflows/execute must fail with an error containing "cannot handle internal-only request operation" and return no response."
- added `r.cluster-setup` (MUST): "Each top-level test builds a single-core in-process cluster with the HTTP handler and DisableCache set, registers the userpass credential backend and the kv-v2 and totp logical backends, starts the cluster, waits for core 0 to become active, and defers cluster cleanup so the test leaves no running core behind."
- added `r.login-mfa` (MUST): "Executing the login-MFA workflow provisions userpass, an admin policy, an identity entity and alias, a TOTP MFA method with a login enforcement, imports the generated TOTP URL into the totp mount, reads a code, and performs the login with the X-Vault-MFA header; the returned token must successfully read auth/token/lookup-self."
- added `r.namespace-isolation` (MUST): "The acceptance test creates a separate child namespace for each subtest (acceptance, recursion, mfa, unauthenticated, alias-lookahead) and runs that subtest against a client scoped with WithNamespace, so the subtests do not share workflow or auth state."
- added `r.namespace-provisioning` (MUST): "Executing the create-namespace workflow with namespace, username and password inputs creates the namespace, mounts userpass auth, writes an ns-admin ACL policy, creates the named user, mounts kv-v2 at secret, and returns output containing the input namespace and an auth client_token."
- added `r.provisioned-token-works` (MUST): "The token returned by the create-namespace workflow must be usable in the newly created child namespace to write and read a kv-v2 secret at secret/data/test."
- added `r.recursion-limit` (MUST): "A workflow whose single flow calls sys/workflows/execute of itself must fail execution with an error containing "too much workflow recursion" instead of looping."
- added `r.template-evaluation` (MUST): "Workflow definitions must support template-evaluated request paths built from input fields and response field selectors, eval of data values from inputs, and output data drawn from a named flow's named response field selector, including sourcing the authentication flow's auth.client_token."
- added `r.unauthenticated-disabled` (MUST): "With AllowUnauthenticatedWorkflows false, a tokenless client must receive a "permission denied" error from sys/workflows/unauthed-execute even for a workflow stored with allow_unauthenticated true."
- added `r.unauthenticated-execute` (MUST): "With AllowUnauthenticatedWorkflows true, a tokenless client may execute a workflow stored with allow_unauthenticated true via sys/workflows/unauthed-execute, but the same tokenless client must receive a "permission denied" error for a workflow stored with allow_unauthenticated false."
- added `r.workflow-lifecycle` (MUST): "Writing a workflow definition to sys/workflows/manage/<name> makes it appear in the List of sys/workflows/manage and makes it executable at sys/workflows/execute/<name>; deleting it removes it so the List returns nil, and a fresh namespace starts with no workflows."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-forwarding

- intent: "" -> "The context exists so the request-forwarding wire protocol, the HA gating rules, the certificate lookups, and the client heartbeat/namespace-key/invalidation loops can be reasoned about and changed as one unit. It is the seam between a standby node and the active node: a standby must forward HTTP requests, ship and fetch namespace seal keys, and stay current on invalidations, while the active node must answer those RPCs and push invalidations. The proto service is named `RequestForwarding` for legacy reasons but carries health, forwarding, key sharing and invalidation RPCs, so the specification must record all of them together."
- added `r.advertise-key-intersection` (MUST): "forwardedRequestRPCServer.AdvertiseNamespaceKeys returns the intersection of the core's namespaces missing keys and the namespaces named in the request, preserving the order of the missing-keys list."
- added `r.check-invalidations-blocks` (MUST): "forwardedRequestRPCServer.CheckInvalidations registers the stream as an invalidation peer, returns the error `not registered; check active server's logs for information` when registration fails, and otherwise blocks on the peer stop channel until the stream is finished so the stream stays open while invalidations are delivered."
- added `r.check-replication-index-uuid` (MUST): "Client.CheckReplicationIndex returns the error `active node has not returned a uuid` when the stored peer uuid is nil or empty, otherwise calls StartInvalidations with that uuid and propagates transport failures, a nil response as `no replication index returned by active node`, and a non-empty response error field; on success it returns the response index."
- added `r.client-cert-lookup` (MUST): "RequestForwardingClusterClient.ClientLookup returns nil certificate and nil error when the parsed cluster certificate is nil or the stored cluster certificate is empty, copies the stored certificate bytes, and returns a TLS certificate carrying that certificate, the local cluster private key and the parsed cert leaf only when one of the acceptable CA subjects equals the parsed certificate raw issuer; otherwise it returns nil, nil."
- added `r.client-heartbeat-loop` (MUST): "Client.Start runs an immediate echo tick and immediate key sync in a goroutine, then loops on the task context, the echo ticker and the namespace sync ticker; on task context cancellation it stops the echo ticker and sets the active node replication state to unknown."
- added `r.client-stop-nil-safe` (MUST): "Client.Stop returns nil on a nil receiver, otherwise stops invalidations and closes the gRPC connection; Client.StopInvalidations returns without action when no invalidations cancel function was set."
- added `r.client-timeouts-and-guard` (MUST): "Each echo tick is bounded by a two second context timeout and stores the active node replication state from the reply after verifying a non-nil `pong` reply; each namespace key synchronization is bounded by a two minute context timeout and is guarded by an atomic boolean so overlapping syncs log a warning and return instead of running concurrently."
- added `r.cluster-info-contract` (MUST): "The package must obtain all cluster identity from its `core` interface: the cluster address, replication state getter and setter, redirect address, local cluster private key, parsed certificate, raw certificate pointer and effective SDK version, plus raft backend access, logging, namespace key listing and mutation, restart, invalidation peer registration and invalidation awaiting; the handler stores only the narrower `clusterInfoGetter` view of the core."
- added `r.echo-heartbeat` (MUST): "forwardedRequestRPCServer.Echo caches an incoming node connection info entry keyed by cluster address when the request cluster address is non-empty, updates raft follower states only when the raft applied index is positive, the raft node id is non-empty and follower states are configured, and replies with message `pong` plus the core replication state and, when a raft backend exists, its applied index and node id."
- added `r.forward-request-serves-http` (MUST): "forwardedRequestRPCServer.ForwardRequest parses an HTTP request out of the forwarded request, serves it through the configured HTTP handler using the RPC response writer, recovers and logs panics with path, error and stack trace instead of failing the RPC, and copies status code, body and header entries into the response."
- added `r.get-keys-fetch` (MUST): "getKeys returns nil when the core reports no namespaces missing keys, requests those namespaces from the active node, returns nil when the reply carries no keys, and otherwise writes the returned batch back through core.SetNamespaceKeys, wrapping failures as `failed loading namespace keys`."
- added `r.get-namespace-keys-partial` (MUST): "forwardedRequestRPCServer.GetNamespaceKeys returns an empty reply after logging an error when the core call fails and returned no keys, logs a warning but continues when it fails and returned some keys, and otherwise returns every returned key as a uuid/key pair."
- added `r.grpc-tuning` (MUST): "The constructor builds the gRPC server with server keepalive time equal to twice `cfg.ClusterHeartbeatInterval` and with max receive and max send message size both set to `math.MaxInt32`."
- added `r.ha-gates-server-registration` (MUST): "NewRequestForwardingHandler resolves `ha := cfg.HA != nil` once to avoid races, and registers the forwarded request RPC server on the gRPC server only when `ha` is true and `cfg.ClusterHandler` is non-nil; the returned handler records the `ha` flag, the named logger `request-forward`, the HTTP/2 server, and a fresh stop channel."
- added `r.handoff-non-ha-closes` (MUST): "Handoff returns nil after warning and closing the TLS connection when the handler is not in HA mode; in HA mode it registers two wait-group units, closes the connection when any of quit channel, caller close channel, or the handler stop channel fires, and serves the connection through the HTTP/2 server with the gRPC server as handler."
- added `r.legacy-package-fallback` (SHOULD): "LegacyPackageFallback must behave as a gRPC unary client interceptor that retries only when the first call returned the Unimplemented status code, rewriting the method from `/forwarding.RequestForwarding/Echo` and `/forwarding.RequestForwarding/ForwardRequest` to the `/vault.RequestForwarding/...` names and returning the original error for any other method or status, so OpenBao 2.6 and later interoperate with nodes up to 2.5."
- added `r.namespace-key-exchange-two-step` (MUST): "Namespace key sharing must stay a two-step advertise-then-send exchange for the standby-to-active direction, as stated by the service comments, so keys the active node already holds are never sent over the wire; the active-to-standby direction is a single GetNamespaceKeys call used for refresh."
- added `r.send-namespace-keys-retry-not-error` (MUST): "forwardedRequestRPCServer.SendNamespaceKeys flattens the repeated uuid/key pairs into a map, calls core.SetNamespaceKeys, logs and replies with `Retry: true` when that call fails, and otherwise replies with an empty reply; the RPC never turns this failure into a gRPC transport error."
- added `r.server-lookup-errors` (MUST): "ServerLookup copies the local cluster certificate and returns a TLS certificate with the local private key and parsed leaf, and returns the error `got forwarding connection but no local cert` when the stored certificate is empty; CALookup returns a single-element slice of the parsed certificate and errors with `forwarding connection client but no local cert` when that certificate is nil."
- added `r.server-name-and-ca` (MUST): "RequestForwardingClusterClient.ServerName returns the parsed cluster certificate subject common name, or the empty string when the parsed certificate is nil; CACert returns the parsed local cluster certificate."
- added `r.service-rpcs` (MUST): "The RequestForwarding service exposes exactly seven RPCs: the unary Echo, ForwardRequest, AdvertiseNamespaceKeys, SendNamespaceKeys, GetNamespaceKeys and StartInvalidations, plus the server-streaming CheckInvalidations; the generated client interface, server interface and unimplemented server must all carry these seven methods, and RegisterRequestForwardingServer must register a handler for each."
- added `r.ship-keys-two-step` (MUST): "shipKeys returns nil when the core reports no namespaces with keys, advertises the core's namespaces with keys, returns nil when the active node requests none of them, fetches keys for exactly the requested namespaces, returns the fetch errors when no keys came back, and otherwise sends the keys and returns a multi-error combining any fetch errors with a send failure."
- added `r.start-invalidations-error-in-body` (MUST): "forwardedRequestRPCServer.StartInvalidations calls core.MarkPeerStarted with the request uuid and always returns a response, carrying the error text `failed to start invalidations; check active logs for more info` in the response Err field rather than returning a gRPC error."
- added `r.stop-drains` (MUST): "Stop of the request forwarding handler sleeps for `cluster.ListenerAcceptDeadline` to let existing RPCs drain, then closes the stop channel and stops the gRPC server, returning nil."
- added `r.stream-invalidations-restart` (MUST): "Client.StreamInvalidations clears the stored peer uuid, opens the check-invalidations stream, stores the uuid from the first received invalidation, and then hands the rest of the loop to a goroutine that awaits each invalidation through the core and stops on a restart indication or receive error; its cleanup cancels the peer loop and calls core.Restart so read state is rebuilt from scratch instead of resuming a stale stream."
- added `r.synchronize-keys-both-directions` (MUST): "Client.SynchronizeKeys runs shipKeys and getKeys concurrently in a wait group and waits for both, logging an error for each direction that fails without aborting the other direction."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-identity

- intent: "" -> "This context exists so the vendored identity store can be described and checked as a unit: what the store persists, which external collaborators it depends on, how OIDC key material and provider resources are created and cached, and how MFA state is read and written. Requirements here pin the exported surface and the contracts the rest of the vault relies on when it mounts the identity backend."
- added `r.alias-change-index` (MUST): "ChangedAliasIndex must report which index of an entity's alias set changed when a new logical.Alias is compared with the stored entity, so the caller can reindex only the affected alias."
- added `r.bucket-key-lookups` (MUST): "Case-folded lookups must be served by the bucket-key helpers: MemDBEntitiesByBucketKeyInTxn, MemDBLocalAliasesByBucketKeyInTxn and MemDBGroupsByBucketKeyInTxn return the entities, local aliases or groups whose sanitized bucket key matches, so name matching is case-insensitive when lower-casing is enabled."
- added `r.case-sensitivity-switch` (MUST): "Case sensitivity handling must be driven by the CaseSensitivity setting on the store, and DisableLowerCasedNames must let a caller turn off the lower-casing of entity and group names."
- added `r.classify-user-error` (MAY): "A helper may classify an entity or alias persistence failure as a user error so the API layer can return a validation response instead of a server error."
- added `r.deletion` (MUST): "Deletion must remove both the memdb rows and the persisted record: MemDBDeleteEntityByID and MemDBDeleteEntityByIDInTxn remove an entity, MemDBDeleteAliasByIDInTxn removes an alias with the groupAlias switch, MemDBDeleteGroupByIDInTxn removes a group, and DeleteAliasesInEntityInTxn removes a set of aliases from an entity."
- added `r.entity-and-alias-persistence` (MUST): "The store must persist and load entities and groups in transactions: UpsertEntity and UpsertEntityInTxn write an entity with its previous entity for index maintenance; MemDBUpsertAliasInTxn, MemDBUpsertEntityInTxn and MemDBUpsertGroupInTxn write aliases, entities and groups into the memdb tables; MemDBAliasByID, MemDBAliasByFactors, MemDBEntityByID and MemDBEntityByName read them back with the clone and groupAlias switches."
- added `r.entity-counting` (SHOULD): "The store should expose entity counts for callers that report usage: CountEntities returns the total for the context's namespace, CountEntitiesByNamespace returns counts keyed by namespace, and CountEntitiesByMountAccessor returns counts keyed by mount accessor."
- added `r.entity-loading` (MUST): "LoadEntities and LoadGroups must populate the in-memory tables for a namespace, honouring a read-only flag that skips writes, so the store reflects the persisted entities and groups after startup or namespace activation."
- added `r.entity-resolution-by-alias` (MUST): "Entity lookup by authentication factors must resolve an entity from a mount accessor and alias name via EntityByAliasFactors, and CreateOrFetchEntity must return the existing entity for a logical.Alias or create a new one, reporting whether it was created, or an error."
- added `r.external-collaborators` (MUST): "The store must depend on narrow interfaces rather than concrete vault types: LocalNode supplies ReplicationState and HAState, Namespacer supplies NamespaceByID and ListNamespaces, TOTPPersister persists a TOTP key for a config and entity, and TokenStorer supplies LookupToken and CreateToken."
- added `r.external-group-refresh` (MUST): "External group membership must be refreshed from login-time aliases by RefreshExternalGroupMembershipsByEntityID, which takes the entity ID, the group aliases and the mount accessor and returns the aliases that were not consumed."
- added `r.group-membership` (MUST): "Group membership must be queryable in both directions: MemDBGroupsByMemberEntityID and MemDBGroupsByMemberEntityIDInTxn return the groups holding an entity, MemDBGroupsByParentGroupID and MemDBGroupsByParentGroupIDInTxn return groups nested under a member group, GroupsByEntityID must split internal and external groups, GroupPoliciesByEntityID must collect policies by group, and MemberGroupIDsByID must list member group IDs of a group."
- added `r.identity-store-construction` (MUST): "IdentityStore must be created by NewIdentityStore, which takes a context, an *IdentityStoreConfig, a *logical.BackendConfig and a log.Logger, and must return the constructed *IdentityStore or an error."
- added `r.logger-injection` (MUST): "LoggerAdder must let a namespace view attach a log.Logger and report UnsafeCrossNamespaceIdentity, so the store can decide whether cross-namespace identity reads are permitted for that view."
- added `r.memdb-transactions` (MUST): "Reads and writes against the in-memory tables must go through Txn, which returns a *memdb.Txn according to the write flag; Invalidate must evict the cached entry for a key so later reads reload from storage; ResetDB must clear store state for a context."
- added `r.mfa-backend-contract` (MUST): "The MFABackend interface must declare the MFA surface the identity store depends on: Lock and Unlock for mutual exclusion, HandleMFAGenerateTOTP for TOTP generation, ValidateAuthEntriesForAccessorOrType for mount-entry validation, CleanupNamespace for namespace teardown, config CRUD via PutMFAConfigByID, ReadMFAConfigByMethodID, DeleteMFAConfigByMethodID and MfaMethodList, login-enforcement CRUD via PutMFALoginEnforcementConfig, ReadMFALoginEnforcementConfigByNameAndNamespace, DeleteMFALoginEnforcementConfigByNameAndNamespace and MfaLoginEnforcementList, plus the memdb accessors MemDBUpsertMFAConfig, MemDBMFAConfigByID, MemDBMFAConfigByName, MemDBMFALoginEnforcementConfigByNameAndNamespace and MemDBUpsertMFALoginEnforcementConfig."
- added `r.namespace-views` (MUST): "The store must attach and detach per-namespace storage: AddNamespaceView registers a LoggerAdder, namespace and logical.Storage, RemoveNamespaceView drops it, View returns the logical.Storage for the context's namespace, and EntityPacker, LocalAliasPacker and GroupPacker return the storagepacker.StoragePacker bound to that namespace."
- added `r.oidc-cache` (MUST): "The OIDC cache must be built by NewOIDCCache from a default expiration and cleanup interval, must key entries by namespace through Get, Set, Delete, Flush and Items, and IsTargetNamespacedKey must decide whether a namespaced key belongs to a target namespace."
- added `r.oidc-identity-id-normalization` (MUST): "LowercaseIdentityIDs must return the given identity IDs with their letter case lowered, and ClientType.String must render a client type as its string form."
- added `r.oidc-key-cache-header` (MUST): "GetKeysCacheControlHeader must return the HTTP cache-control header value for a namespace's OIDC keys, or an error when it cannot be determined."
- added `r.oidc-key-rotation` (MUST): "NamedKey must generate and persist OIDC signing keys: GenerateAndSetKey writes the current key, GenerateAndSetNextKey writes the next key used for rotation, and OidcPeriodicFunc must run the periodic rotation work driven by those keys."
- added `r.oidc-provider-resources` (MUST): "OIDC provider state must be created, checked and loaded: StoreOIDCDefaultResources writes the default assignment, scope, client and provider records for a namespace, LoadOIDCClients loads stored clients into the store, and the PathOIDCKeyExistenceCheck, PathOIDCRoleExistenceCheck, PathOIDCAssignmentExistenceCheck, PathOIDCScopeExistenceCheck, PathOIDCClientExistenceCheck and PathOIDCProviderExistenceCheck handlers report whether the named resource exists, returning an error when the read fails."
- added `r.sanitization` (MUST): "Before persistence the store must normalize input: SanitizeAlias and SanitizeEntity clean an alias and entity against the store's case and namespace rules, and SanitizeAndUpsertGroup cleans a group and its member group IDs then upserts it."
- added `r.user-error` (MUST): "userError must wrap an underlying error and satisfy the error interface: Error returns the message, Unwrap returns the wrapped error, and Is reports whether the wrapped error matches, so callers can distinguish user-input failures from internal failures."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-policy

- intent: "" -> "The context exists to describe the vendored ACL and policy store package so that other parts of deno-kcp that depend on policy evaluation can be read and changed without re-deriving this package's behaviour. It documents how rules are parsed, how an ACL is assembled from named and templated policies, how requests are checked, and how the store caches, lists and invalidates policies. It anchors every statement to the actual functions and methods in the copied files."
- added `r.acl-construction` (MUST): "NewACL builds an ACL from a policy list in the namespace carried by the context: it errors when the context has no namespace, rejects any policy whose Type is not the ACL type, and when a policy named root is present it must be the only policy or construction fails; the root policy's namespace becomes the ACL root."
- added `r.allow-operation` (MUST): "ACL.AllowOperation evaluates a logical.Request against the exact, prefix and segment-wildcard rules and reports the outcome in ACLResults, filling in whether the request is allowed, whether it comes from the root policy, whether root privileges were required and any per-path permission detail; capCheckOnly limits the work to a capability check."
- added `r.auth-and-sentinel-results` (MUST): "AuthResults carries the combined verdict of a policy check: the ACL result, the sentinel result, the final Allowed and RootPrivs flags, whether the denial should be reported as an error, and a multierror aggregating failures, so callers have one value describing the whole decision."
- added `r.capabilities-and-nonexact` (MUST): "ACL.Capabilities returns the capability names granted to a path, and ACL.CheckAllowedFromNonExactPaths resolves permissions from the non-exact rules for a path, optionally treating it as a bare mount, returning nil when no rule applies."
- added `r.check-opts` (MUST): "CheckOpts tells the check whether root privileges are required for the request and whether the request is unauthenticated, so a caller can run only external policy checks against a login path."
- added `r.clone-deep-copy` (MUST): "ACLPermissions.Clone and ControlGroup.Clone return deep copies of their receiver and report an error rather than returning a partially copied value, so merging rules never aliases the source policy's maps."
- added `r.control-group-model` (MUST): "A policy can carry control-group requirements: ControlGroup holds the factors and the identity list, ControlGroupFactor names a factor, IdentityFactor describes an identity-based factor with its entity and group names, and ControlGroupIdentity names an entity and its groups, so the store can express and copy multi-factor access conditions."
- added `r.parse-acl-policy` (MUST): "ParseACLPolicy turns a raw rules string into a Policy bound to the given namespace, and ParseACLPolicyWithTemplating does the same while optionally performing identity templating with a list of blocked substitutions, an entity and its groups; both return an error instead of a partial policy when the rules do not parse."
- added `r.policy-decode-clone` (MUST): "Policy.Decode materialises the policy named by the caller against a namespace, and Policy.ShallowClone returns a copy that shares the path and rule data so callers can rename or retype a policy without mutating the cached original."
- added `r.policy-type` (MUST): "Type names the kind of policy and Type.String renders it as the text used in storage paths and error messages, so a policy's type round-trips from its stored name."
- added `r.rule-accessors` (SHOULD): "ACL.ExactRules and ACL.PrefixRules expose the internal radix trees and ACL.Root exposes the namespace of a root ACL so that callers such as list filtering can inspect the rule set directly."
- added `r.rule-indexing` (MUST): "NewACL indexes each non-expired policy path into exact rules or prefix rules by its IsPrefix flag, keeps segment-wildcard paths in a separate map, and clones and merges permissions when several policies name the same path, so the ACL holds one merged permission set per path."
- added `r.store-acl-assembly` (MUST): "Store.ACL assembles an ACL from the named token policies of each namespace in the policy-name map, appends any pre-fetched policies passed by the caller, and for templated ACL policies re-parses the raw text with the entity and its direct and inherited groups before handing everything to NewACL; it errors when a namespace is missing, when a policy cannot be fetched or parsed, or when the ACL cannot be constructed."
- added `r.store-acl-view` (MUST): "Store.GetACLView returns the barrier view that holds the ACL policies for a namespace, so callers read and write that namespace's policy storage instead of the base view."
- added `r.store-construction` (MUST): "NewStore builds a policy Store over the supplied core, base barrier view, system view and logger, and returns an error when the store cannot be initialised; the same core supplies namespace lookup by ID, the identity store and the namespace barrier view through core.NamespaceByID, core.IdentityStore and core.NamespaceView."
- added `r.store-default-and-load` (SHOULD): "Store.LoadDefaultPolicies installs the built-in default policies when they are absent, and Store.LoadACLPolicy stores the given policy text under the given name, both returning an error if the write fails."
- added `r.store-delete-and-invalidate` (MUST): "Store.DeletePolicy removes a named policy and Store.DeletePolicyForce removes it even when it is protected from ordinary deletion; Store.Invalidate drops one named policy of a type from the cache, Store.InvalidateNamespace drops every cached policy of a namespace, and Store.PurgeCache clears the whole cache."
- added `r.store-list` (MUST): "Store.ListPolicies lists stored policies of one type and Store.ListPoliciesWithPrefix narrows that list to names starting with a prefix; both accept omitNonAssignable and drop non-assignable policies when it is set, returning an error if the barrier listing fails."
- added `r.store-name-sanitisation` (MUST): "Store.SanitizeName maps a caller-supplied policy name to the canonical form used as the storage key, so the same policy is addressed by one name regardless of the spelling given."
- added `r.store-set-and-get` (MUST): "Store.SetPolicy writes a policy to the barrier for its namespace and can enforce a compare-and-swap version, while Store.GetPolicy reads a policy by name and type and Store.GetNonEGPPolicyType reports the stored type of a non-endpoint-governing policy, all returning errors on storage failure and nil when nothing is stored."
- added `r.templating-substitution-limits` (MUST): "When re-parsing a templated policy the store blocks the substitutions the policy did not opt into: it blocks "/" unless AllowSlashesInIdentityTemplates is set, and blocks "*" and "+" unless AllowWildcardsInIdentityTemplates is set, so a template can never widen a policy path beyond its declared permissions."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-policy-policytest

- intent: "" -> "This context exists to pin the observable behaviour of layered Vault ACL evaluation: an ACL assembled from several stacked policies must allow, deny or grant root privileges on exactly the paths and operations the table lists. It lives in policytest rather than a _test.go file so multiple packages can import it and run the identical suite against ACLs they build by different construction paths, which keeps layered-policy resolution honest across callers without duplicating the expectation table."
- added `r.baseline-not-root` (MUST): "Before the case table runs, a read request for path sys/mount/foo must be evaluated through acl.AllowOperation with a namespace-scoped context and the root-privilege argument false, and the result must not report RootPrivs; a root result fails the test with "unexpected root"."
- added `r.caller-supplied-acl` (MUST): "TestLayeredACL must accept the ACL and namespace under test as parameters rather than constructing them, so any caller can run the same suite against an ACL it built by its own layering path."
- added `r.case-table` (MUST): "The suite must carry a table of 26 cases, each fixing a logical.Operation, a path, an expected Allowed value and an expected RootPrivs value; 11 cases expect allowed, 15 expect denied, and 5 expect root privileges."
- added `r.covered-semantics` (MUST): "The table must cover the layered-policy semantics it documents: the root path denied read but allowed help without root privileges, wildcard grants under dev/ and stage/aws/ that do carry root privileges, a denied sys/status read next to an allowed sys/seal update with root privileges, hidden dev/hide/ segments denied, stage/aws/policy/foo denied for update, and read/list/update/create/patch all denied on paths no policy names (foo/bar and baz/quux)."
- added `r.fresh-request-per-case` (MUST): "Each case must build its own logical.Request and namespace context, set the case operation and path on it, and call acl.AllowOperation with the root-privilege argument false, so no request state leaks between cases."
- added `r.mismatch-fails` (MUST): "A case must fail the test when the observed Allowed value differs from the expected one, and separately when the observed RootPrivs value differs, reporting the case and both observed values in the fatal message."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-quotas

- intent: "" -> "This context exists so that the vault can enforce per-request quotas, chiefly rate limits, without the request path knowing how rules are stored or matched. It gives the rest of the vault one registry object, Manager, that owns the lifecycle of quota rules: creation and persistence, lookup by ID, name or request factors, matching of an incoming Request to the rule that governs it, evaluation of that rule into a Response, and cleanup when mounts, namespaces or backends go away. The Quota interface keeps the rule kinds pluggable, and the configuration surface (audit logging, response headers, exempt paths) lets operators tune the rate limit behavior at runtime."
- added `r.access-quota-id` (MUST): "The Access interface exposes QuotaID so a request's resolved identity can be mapped to a quota rule; the concrete access value returns that identifier."
- added `r.lease-action-string` (SHOULD): "LeaseAction.String renders a lease action as its text form: loaded, created, deleted or allow for known values, and "unknown" for any other value."
- added `r.lease-information` (MAY): "QuotaLeaseInformation carries lease bookkeeping for a quota evaluation alongside the Response returned to the caller."
- added `r.manager-construction` (MUST): "NewManager returns a Manager bound to a logger, a cluster metric sink and a deadlock-detection flag; DetectDeadlocks reports whether deadlock detection was requested at construction."
- added `r.query-and-apply-quota` (MUST): "QueryQuota selects the quota rule that governs a Request, QueryResolveRoleQuotas reports whether role quotas must be resolved for the request, and ApplyQuota evaluates the governing rule and returns a Response describing the outcome."
- added `r.quota-clone` (MUST): "Quota.Clone returns a copy of the calling rule so callers can mutate a rule without altering the stored instance; RateLimitQuota.Clone provides that copy for the rate limit rule type."
- added `r.quota-crud` (MUST): "Manager persists, reads and removes quota rules: SetQuota stores a rule under its type, LoadQuota loads one by type and name, DeleteQuota removes one, and QuotaNames lists the rule names registered for a given type."
- added `r.quota-interface-contract` (MUST): "Every quota rule satisfies the Quota interface: it can evaluate a request through allow, report its identifier and name, report whether it is inheritable, be initialized with a logger and metric sink, be closed on deletion, be cloned, and have its mount and namespace paths rewritten. RateLimitQuota is the concrete implementation of that interface."
- added `r.quota-lookup-by-factor` (MUST): "Manager resolves a quota rule by identifier, by name, or by request factors (namespace path, mount path, path suffix and role), returning the matching rule or an error when no rule matches."
- added `r.quota-storage-path` (MUST): "QuotaStoragePath derives the storage location of a quota rule from its type and name, and the manager reads and writes rule definitions at that path so persistence survives restart."
- added `r.quota-type-string` (SHOULD): "Type.String renders a quota type as its text form so the type can be used as a key and in operator-facing output."
- added `r.rate-limit-config-toggles` (MUST): "Manager holds the rate limit runtime configuration: setters and getters for audit logging and response headers, an exempt-path set whose membership RateLimitPathExempt answers, persisted configuration read by LoadConfig and exposed by Config."
- added `r.rate-limit-construction` (MUST): "NewRateLimitQuota constructs a rate limit rule from a name, namespace path, mount path, path suffix, role, rate, interval, block duration and inheritable flag, returning the rule the manager will register."
- added `r.request-factors` (MUST): "Request carries the namespace path, mount path, path suffix, role and client identity that quota matching consumes, so QueryQuota and ApplyQuota can decide which rule applies and whether the request is allowed."
- added `r.setup-reset-invalidate` (SHOULD): "Setup loads the manager's quota and configuration state from vault storage, Reset clears that in-memory state, and Invalidate drops a single cached entry identified by key."
- added `r.topology-change-hooks` (MUST): "When a mount is remounted, a namespace is deleted, or a backend is disabled, the manager rewrites the mount and namespace paths of affected quota rules or removes rules that no longer have a target."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-routing

- intent: "" -> "This context exists so the routing layer of the vendored OpenBao tree can be described and reasoned about on its own: how mounts are registered, looked up, tainted, remounted and removed, how a request path is matched to a backend, and how unauthenticated login paths are parsed into radix trees. It gives the specification a single place to state the invariants the router must keep, because the surrounding vault core calls into these functions on every request and on every mount change."
- added `r.deserializable-contract` (MUST): "The Deserializable interface exposes Deserialize returning a map[string]any, and both MountEntry and RouteEntry implement it so mount and route records can be turned into maps for storage and audit without a per-type switch."
- added `r.mount-config-structs` (MUST): "MountConfig, APIMountConfig, UserLockoutConfig and APIUserLockoutConfig carry the per-mount settings that travel with a MountEntry, each field tagged for json, structs and mapstructure decoding so the same config round-trips through storage, command-line and HCL paths, and ListingVisibilityType names the allowed listing visibility values."
- added `r.mount-entry-api-path` (MUST): "MountEntry.APIPath returns the namespace path joined with the mount path, prefixed with CredentialRoutePrefix when the entry's Table is CredentialTableType; MountEntry.APIPathNoNamespace returns the same path without the namespace prefix."
- added `r.mount-entry-cache-refresh` (SHOULD): "MountEntry.SyncCache refreshes the synthesized config cache of the entry so audit key lists and similar derived values are read without recomputing them on every request, and MountEntry.IsExternalPlugin reports whether the entry's backend is an external plugin."
- added `r.mount-entry-deep-clone` (MUST): "MountEntry.Clone returns a deep copy of the mount entry made through copystructure, and returns the copy error instead of a partial entry when the copy fails."
- added `r.mount-entry-mount-class` (MUST): "MountEntry.MountClass returns the empty string when the entry has no accessor or its path is under the system mount path prefix, returns the credential plugin type for credential-table entries, and the secrets plugin type for all other entries."
- added `r.mount-table-delta-and-order` (MUST): "MountTable.Delta compares the receiver against a new table and reports the additions and the deletions between them, and the sort helpers order a table by path, with the depth variant putting deeper paths first so longest-prefix matching works."
- added `r.mount-table-lookup-and-mutation` (MUST): "MountTable resolves entries by path, by backend UUID and by namespace, returns an error when a lookup has no match, deletes the entry at a path and returns it from Remove, marks the entry at a namespace and path as tainted through SetTaint, and supports a ShallowClone that copies the table without deep-copying its entries."
- added `r.router-construction-and-reset` (MUST): "NewRouter builds a Router around the supplied hclog logger with empty route state, and Router.Reset clears that state so the router can be reused without the previous mounts."
- added `r.router-identity-lookups` (MUST): "Router.MatchingMountByUUID and Router.MatchingMountByAccessor return the mount entry for a barrier UUID and for a human-readable accessor respectively, Router.MatchingMountByAPIPath returns the API path of the matching mount, Router.ValidateMountByAccessor returns a ValidateMountResponse for an accessor, and Router.MountConflict reports the conflicting mount path for a proposed path."
- added `r.router-mount-lifecycle` (MUST): "Router.Mount registers a logical backend at a prefix together with its mount entry and storage view and fails on a conflicting prefix, Router.Unmount removes the route at a prefix, Router.Remount moves a route from source to destination while running a callback on the moved entry, and Router.Taint and Router.Untaint flip the taint flag of the route at a path."
- added `r.router-path-classification` (MUST): "Router.RootPath reports whether a path is a root path and Router.LoginPath reports whether it is a login path, both by consulting the radix trees that RouteEntry.SetRootPaths and RouteEntry.SetLoginPaths install on the route entry."
- added `r.router-path-matching` (MUST): "Router.MatchingMount and Router.MatchingPrefixInternal return the longest matching mount prefix for a request path, Router.MatchingMountEntry, Router.MatchingBackend and Router.MatchingSystemView return the backend objects registered for that prefix, and the storage lookups translate an API or storage path into the matching logical.Storage, with MatchingStoragePrefixByAPIPath and MatchingAPIPrefixByStoragePath reporting the prefixes in both directions."
- added `r.router-request-dispatch` (MUST): "Router.Route dispatches a logical request to the backend matched by its path and returns the logical response and error, and Router.RouteExistenceCheck performs the same dispatch while also reporting whether the path exists and whether the check itself failed."
- added `r.router-resolve-path` (MUST): "Router.ResolvePath resolves a mount and a path with request data into the concrete storage path for that mount, and returns an error when the mount cannot be resolved."
- added `r.router-salt-invalidate-records` (MUST): "Router.SetTokenStoreSaltFunc installs the function used to obtain a token store salt, RouteEntry.SaltID uses that function to salt an identifier, Router.Invalidate drops a cached key and reports whether it was present, Router.Get returns the route entry for a path, and Router.GetRecords returns the deserialized records for a tag."
- added `r.routing-test-coverage` (SHOULD): "The package's test file exercises the mount lifecycle and path classification, covering mount, credential mount, unmount, remount, namespace mount conflicts, root path, login path, taint and untaint behaviour."
- added `r.unauthenticated-path-parsing` (MUST): "ParseUnauthenticatedPaths validates the supplied path patterns and builds a loginPathsEntry from them, returning an error for a malformed pattern, and PathsToRadix builds a radix tree keyed by those paths so login path matching is a tree lookup."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-seal

- intent: "" -> "The context exists so the vault's seal access path is described as an interface plus adapters rather than as concrete wrapper types. Access is the contract the barrier depends on: it is a wrapping.Wrapper and a wrapping.InitFinalizer, and it additionally hands out the underlying wrapper through GetWrapper. NewAccess turns an arbitrary wrapping.Wrapper into that contract, delegating KeyId, Type, Encrypt, Decrypt, Init, Finalize and SetConfig straight through. The remaining types exist to satisfy that contract in specific roles: ShamirWrapper reports the Shamir wrapper type, Envelope adds AAD-carrying envelope encryption with a one-time init and per-call timing metrics, and the testing helpers produce Access values whose Encrypt and Decrypt can be made to fail on demand so callers can exercise error paths."
- added `r.access-delegates-to-wrapper` (MUST): "Every access method forwards to the wrapped wrapping.Wrapper: KeyId, SetConfig, Init, Type, Encrypt, Decrypt and Finalize take a context and the caller's wrapping.Option values and return the wrapped wrapper's results unchanged, so the access type adds no policy of its own."
- added `r.access-interface-shape` (MUST): "Access is satisfied only by a type that is simultaneously a wrapping.Wrapper with an InitFinalizer and that also provides GetWrapper returning the wrapping.Wrapper behind it, so callers can both use the seal directly and reach the concrete wrapper underneath."
- added `r.envelope-lazy-init` (MUST): "Envelope performs its initialization exactly once, on the first call to Encrypt, through a sync.Once guard, so that a zero-value Envelope obtained from NewEnvelope is usable without any separate setup call."
- added `r.envelope-metrics` (SHOULD): "Envelope.Encrypt measures its own duration under the metrics key seal/envelope/encrypt before returning, so envelope encryption latency is observable."
- added `r.envelope-round-trip` (MUST): "Envelope.Encrypt takes plaintext and additional authenticated data and returns a wrapping.EnvelopeInfo produced by wrapping.EnvelopeEncrypt with wrapping.WithAad(aad); Envelope.Decrypt takes a wrapping.EnvelopeInfo and the same additional authenticated data and returns the recovered plaintext, so that data encrypted by Envelope can be decrypted by the same Envelope."
- added `r.envelope-test-coverage` (SHOULD): "The envelope test exercises Envelope through NewEnvelope, encrypting and then decrypting with matching additional authenticated data to assert the recovered plaintext equals the input."
- added `r.newaccess-wraps-wrapper` (MUST): "NewAccess takes a wrapping.Wrapper and returns an Access whose GetWrapper returns that same wrapper, making any wrapping.Wrapper usable as a seal Access without the caller implementing the interface."
- added `r.shamir-wrapper-type` (MUST): "ShamirWrapper implements the wrapper Type query and reports the Shamir wrapper type, and NewShamirWrapper returns a ready-to-use *ShamirWrapper so the type can be obtained without constructing the struct literal."
- added `r.test-seal-construction` (MUST): "NewTestSeal takes a *TestSealOpts and returns both an Access and the *ToggleableWrapper backing it, while NewToggleableTestSeal takes the same options and returns an Access plus a func(error) that sets the failure on that wrapper, so tests can hold the Access and still reach in to break it."
- added `r.toggleable-error-injection` (MUST): "ToggleableWrapper.SetError records an error, and while it is set ToggleableWrapper.Encrypt and ToggleableWrapper.Decrypt return that error instead of performing the operation, letting tests drive the error paths of callers that hold only the Access."
- added `r.toggleable-wrapper-type` (MUST): "ToggleableWrapper answers the wrapper Type query as well, so a toggleable test seal is interchangeable with a production wrapper anywhere an Access or wrapping.Wrapper is accepted."

### third-party-openbao-internal-vault-tokens

- intent: "" -> "The context exists so the token wire format is described where the rest of the codebase can reason about it without reading the whole vendored file. Token signing, token lookup and token indexing in OpenBao all pass these two structs across package boundaries, so anything that mints, parses, hashes or stores a vault token depends on the field numbering, the protobuf tags and the nil-safe getters recorded here. Recording them as a specification fixes the shape that other contexts must not break: field numbers are part of the on-disk and over-the-wire contract, and the getters are part of the in-process contract."
- added `r.message-internal-state` (MUST): "Both message types keep a protoimpl.MessageState, an unknownFields block and a sizeCache beside their declared fields, so unknown wire fields survive a round trip and the encoded size is cached; these members stay unexported and are not part of the token data."
- added `r.signed-token-descriptor` (MUST): "SignedToken.Descriptor returns the raw gzipped file descriptor bytes and the index path that locates SignedToken inside that descriptor."
- added `r.signed-token-getters-nil-safe` (MUST): "SignedToken.GetTokenVersion, SignedToken.GetHmac and SignedToken.GetToken return the corresponding field of the receiver, and each returns the field's zero value (0 or nil) when the receiver is nil, so callers read signed token material without a nil check."
- added `r.signed-token-reflection` (MUST): "SignedToken.ProtoMessage marks the type as a proto message, and SignedToken.ProtoReflect returns the protoreflect.Message view of the receiver for reflective read and write of its fields."
- added `r.signed-token-reset-zeroes` (MUST): "SignedToken.Reset replaces the receiver with a zero-value SignedToken and stores the file-level message info for message index 0 in the proto message state, so a reused value carries no data from its previous use."
- added `r.signed-token-string-renders` (MUST): "SignedToken.String returns the protobuf text representation produced by protoimpl.X.MessageStringOf for the receiver."
- added `r.token-descriptor` (MUST): "Token.Descriptor returns the raw gzipped file descriptor bytes and the index path that locates Token inside that descriptor."
- added `r.token-getters-nil-safe` (MUST): "Token.GetRandom, Token.GetIndexEpoch and Token.GetLocalIndex return the corresponding field of the receiver, and each returns the field's zero value (empty string or 0) when the receiver is nil."
- added `r.token-reflection` (MUST): "Token.ProtoMessage marks the type as a proto message, and Token.ProtoReflect returns the protoreflect.Message view of the receiver."
- added `r.token-reset-zeroes` (MUST): "Token.Reset replaces the receiver with a zero-value Token and stores the file-level message info for message index 1 in the proto message state."
- added `r.token-string-renders` (MUST): "Token.String returns the protobuf text representation produced by protoimpl.X.MessageStringOf for the receiver."
- added `r.token-wire-field-numbers` (MUST): "Token carries Random as protobuf field 1 (string, the unencoded equivalent of the former randbase62 value), IndexEpoch as field 3 (uint32 varint, JSON name indexEpoch) and LocalIndex as field 50 (string, JSON name localIndex, the storage state required to have this token); these numbers and JSON names are the wire and JSON contract."

### third-party-openbao-internal-version

- intent: "" -> "This context exists so the OpenBao binary can name itself. Every component that prints, logs, or transmits a version — the HTTP audit backend's User-Agent, the CLI commands, the sys/health endpoint, service registration, and the seal-status API — calls into this package instead of hardcoding a string. It separates the injected build facts (ldflags variables) from the presentation rules, so a single place decides how a commit, a prerelease tag, vendor metadata, and a commit date combine into a user-visible version string."
- added `r.cgo-flag` (MUST): "The cgo build-tagged file must set CgoEnabled to true at init, leaving it false in builds without the cgo tag so callers can tell whether the binary was built with cgo."
- added `r.commit-date-fallback` (SHOULD): "The package must fill CommitDate from the deprecated BuildDate variable at init when CommitDate is empty, so builds that still pass only BuildDate keep a commit date in the rendered version string."
- added `r.full-version-number-format` (MUST): "VersionInfo.FullVersionNumber must return "OpenBao (version unknown)" when the package-level Version and VersionPrerelease are both "unknown"; otherwise it must render "OpenBao v<Version>", append "-<VersionPrerelease>" and "+<VersionMetadata>" when those are non-empty, append " (<Revision>)" only when rev is true and Revision is non-empty, and finish with ", committed <CommitDate>" when CommitDate is non-empty."
- added `r.getversion-resolution` (MUST): "GetVersion must return a new VersionInfo whose Revision is GitCommit and CommitDate is CommitDate, choosing GitDescribe as Version when GitDescribe is non-empty; when GitDescribe is empty, the resolved prerelease is empty, and VersionPrerelease is non-empty, it must substitute the prerelease "dev"."
- added `r.ldflags-variables` (MUST): "The package must expose GitCommit, GitDescribe, CommitDate, VersionMetadata, and the unexported fullVersion (default "2.0.0-HEAD") as the variables the build sets via ldflags, and must derive Version and VersionPrerelease at init by trimming fullVersion and cutting it at the first "-"."
- added `r.version-info-fields` (MUST): "VersionInfo must carry exactly the build identity of one binary as five string fields: Revision, Version, VersionPrerelease, VersionMetadata, and CommitDate."
- added `r.version-number-format` (MUST): "VersionInfo.VersionNumber must return "(version unknown)" when the package-level Version and VersionPrerelease are both "unknown"; otherwise it must begin with the receiver's Version and append "-<VersionPrerelease>" when the prerelease is non-empty, then "+<VersionMetadata>" when the metadata is non-empty."

### third-party-openbao-release

- intent: "" -> "The context exists so that OpenBao releases can be produced as native Linux packages without hand-written per-format stubs: nfpm reads this one YAML manifest and emits both deb and rpm artifacts. It pins the packaging contract that release automation depends on — package name and metadata, GOARCH/GOOS/VERSION substitution, the install layout and file modes, the config files that must survive upgrades, the maintainer script hooks, and the signing key source — so a change to any of those is a change to what ships to package repositories."
- added `r.build-time-substitution` (MUST): "Architecture, platform and version are not hard-coded; they are taken from the GOARCH, GOOS and VERSION environment variables respectively, so the same manifest yields per-target packages when release automation sets those variables."
- added `r.install-layout-and-modes` (MUST): "Packaged contents map build outputs to install paths with explicit file modes: ./bin/bao goes to /usr/bin/bao with mode 0755, and ./LICENSE goes to /usr/share/doc/openbao/copyright with mode 0644."
- added `r.maintainer-scripts` (MUST): "The manifest wires the maintainer script hooks preinstall to ./.release/linux/preinst, postinstall to ./.release/linux/postinst, and postremove to ./.release/linux/postrm."
- added `r.package-identity` (MUST): "The manifest declares the package identity and metadata that both deb and rpm artifacts carry: name openbao, vendor OpenBao, homepage https://openbao.org, maintainer OpenBao <openbao@lists.openssf.org>, license MPL-2.0, section default, and the multi-line description stating that OpenBao manages, stores and distributes sensitive data including secrets, certificates and keys."
- added `r.package-signing` (MUST): "Both the deb and rpm sections take their signature key file from the GPG_KEY_FILE environment variable, so signed packages require that variable to name a readable key file at build time."
- added `r.preserved-config-files` (MUST): "Three files are installed as config|noreplace with mode 0644 so a package upgrade does not overwrite operator edits: ./.release/linux/package/etc/openbao/openbao.env to /etc/openbao/openbao.env, ./.release/linux/package/etc/openbao/openbao.hcl to /etc/openbao/openbao.hcl, and ./.release/linux/package/usr/lib/systemd/system/openbao.service to /usr/lib/systemd/system/openbao.service."
- added `r.relationship-declarations` (MUST): "The package declares it provides openbao, conflicts with the bao and bao-hsm packages, replaces bao, and depends on openssl, so a package manager treats an OpenBao install as mutually exclusive with the legacy bao packages and pulls in the OpenSSL runtime dependency."

### third-party-openbao-sdk-database-dbplugin

- intent: "" -> "The package exists so that a database secrets engine plugin, whether compiled into the host as a builtin or run as a separate go-plugin process, exposes one uniform Database contract to the caller. It carries that contract across the gRPC boundary in both directions (server-side gRPCServer adapter, client-side gRPCClient adapter), converts the JSON-encoded config bytes to and from map[string]any, normalizes shutdown and unimplemented-static-account failures into sentinel errors, and instruments every call so the host can report per-database-type metrics and trace logs."
- added `r.client-close-kills-plugin` (MUST): "DatabasePluginClient embeds Database and holds the go-plugin Client; its Close closes the embedded Database first and then calls Kill on the plugin client, returning the Database close error."
- added `r.client-dispense` (MUST): "NewPluginClient registers GRPCDatabasePlugin under plugin-set versions 3 and 4 keyed by the name database, starts the runner via RunMetadataMode when isMetadataMode is set and Run otherwise, dispenses database from the RPC client, and accepts only a *gRPCClient, returning unsupported client type for anything else."
- added `r.client-interface-methods` (MUST): "DatabaseClient.RotateRootCredentials, DatabaseClient.RevokeUser and DatabaseClient.Initialize are the client-side stubs the gRPCClient adapter invokes, sending the corresponding proto request over the connection and surfacing the transport error to the caller."
- added `r.database-contract` (MUST): "Database is the contract every database plugin implementation satisfies: Type reports the backend type name, CreateUser/RenewUser/RevokeUser manage dynamic users against Statements and UsernameConfig, RotateRootCredentials and Init return a config map that persists across restarts, GenerateCredentials and SetCredentials support static accounts, and Close tears down the underlying connection."
- added `r.error-sanitizer` (MUST): "DatabaseErrorSanitizerMiddleware wraps a Database and passes every returned error through sanitize, which replaces url.Error with unable to parse connection url, unwraps and re-wraps pgconn.ParseConfigError, and when secretsFn is set replaces each non-empty secret key found in the message while preserving the gRPC status code."
- added `r.factory-wrapping` (MUST): "PluginFactoryVersion reads Type from the built database, then wraps it in databaseMetricsMiddleware carrying that type string for every call, and additionally wraps it in databaseTracingMiddleware when the plugin-named logger reports IsTrace, logging the transport it detected."
- added `r.grpc-client-adapter` (MUST): "GRPCDatabasePlugin.GRPCClient returns a gRPCClient bound to the connection, the DatabaseClient and the doneCtx; every gRPCClient call derives a cancellable context tied to doneCtx through pluginutil.CtxCancelIfCanceled, and when doneCtx is already done the call returns ErrPluginShutdown instead of the transport error."
- added `r.grpc-server-adapter` (MUST): "GRPCDatabasePlugin.GRPCServer wraps Impl in DatabaseErrorSanitizerMiddleware and registers a gRPCServer over it; the gRPCServer adapter converts proto requests to Database calls, marshals Init and RotateRootCredentials results to JSON bytes in Config, validates each Expiration timestamp before use, and implements the deprecated Initialize as a call to Init."
- added `r.handshake` (MUST): "Client and server share one handshakeConfig with ProtocolVersion 4, MagicCookieKey VAULT_DATABASE_PLUGIN and MagicCookieValue 926a0820-aea2-be28-51d6-83cdf00e8edb; the comment states this is a UX feature that stops bad plugins running, not a security feature."
- added `r.metrics-middleware` (MUST): "databaseMetricsMiddleware forwards each Database call and records, under both database.<Op> and database.<typeStr>.<Op>, a call counter plus an error counter on failure and a timer via MeasureSince, including for CreateUser, RenewUser, RevokeUser, SetCredentials, GenerateCredentials and Close."
- added `r.pb-message-shape` (MUST): "The legacy protobuf InitializeRequest carries Config as raw bytes and VerifyConnection, and the service message set exposes accessors such as TypeResponse.GetType and StaticUserConfig.GetUsername/GetPassword that the adapters use to move config and static-account fields across the boundary."
- added `r.pb-service` (MUST): "The generated gRPC service exposes Type, CreateUser, RenewUser, RevokeUser, RotateRootCredentials, Init, Close, SetCredentials, GenerateCredentials and the deprecated Initialize on both DatabaseServer and DatabaseClient, with UnimplementedDatabaseServer answering every method with codes.Unimplemented so implementations stay forward compatible."
- added `r.plugin-factory` (MUST): "PluginFactory delegates to PluginFactoryVersion with an empty version; PluginFactoryVersion looks the plugin up in the catalog as consts.PluginTypeDatabase, and when the runner is Builtin it casts BuiltinFactory's result to Database (rejecting a non-Database with unsupported database type), otherwise it builds a DatabasePluginClient and records the transport as gRPC."
- added `r.serve` (MUST): "Serve builds the config from ServeConfig and hands it to plugin.Serve; ServeConfig first calls pluginutil.OptionallyEnableMlock and returns nil after printing the error when mlock cannot be enabled, then registers GRPCDatabasePlugin for versions 3 and 4 under the name database with GRPCServer set to plugin.DefaultGRPCServer and the caller's TLSProvider."
- added `r.server-interface-method` (MUST): "DatabaseServer.RenewUser and DatabaseServer.GenerateCredentials are the server-side entry points for lease renewal and generated-password requests, mapping the proto request onto the wrapped Database and returning an Empty response or the implementation error."
- added `r.static-unsupported` (MUST): "gRPCClient.SetCredentials treats a gRPC Unimplemented status as ErrPluginStaticUnsupported (database plugin does not support Static Accounts) so callers can fall back for plugins predating static accounts."
- added `r.tracing-middleware` (MUST): "databaseTracingMiddleware forwards each Database call while emitting Trace-level started and finished log lines with the error and elapsed duration, and is only installed when the caller's logger is in trace mode."

### third-party-openbao-sdk-database-dbplugin-v5

- intent: "" -> "This context is the client/server contract for running an OpenBao database secrets engine backend as a separate plugin process. It exists so that a plugin binary implements one Go interface and the host can call it over gRPC without sharing a type identity, while the host keeps tracing, metrics and error sanitization in front of every call."
- added `r.credential-types` (MUST): "CredentialType must be a named string type whose String method renders the credential type for display, and InitializeResponse must offer SetSupportedCredentialTypes to record the credential types the plugin supports so they can be marshalled back to the host."
- added `r.database-interface` (MUST): "The Database interface must expose exactly Initialize, NewUser, UpdateUser, DeleteUser, Type and Close, each taking a context and the corresponding request struct and returning the corresponding response struct plus an error; Type and Close take no arguments and Close returns only an error."
- added `r.error-sanitizer` (MUST): "NewDatabaseErrorSanitizerMiddleware must wrap a Database with a secret-provider function so that errors returned from Initialize, NewUser, UpdateUser, DeleteUser, Type and Close have the secret values stripped before they reach the caller, and the wrapper must pass through PluginVersion unchanged."
- added `r.grpc-client-proxy` (MUST): "gRPCClient must satisfy Database by converting each SDK request into the matching protobuf message, issuing the call on the gRPC client connection, and converting the protobuf response back into the SDK response; PluginVersion must return the logical.PluginVersion of the transport and Close must tear down the connection."
- added `r.grpc-plugin-hooks` (MUST): "GRPCDatabasePlugin must supply the go-plugin gRPC hooks: GRPCServer must register the gRPCServer implementation on the given grpc.Server, and GRPCClient must build the gRPCClient for the given client connection and return it as the plugin implementation value."
- added `r.grpc-server-dispatch` (MUST): "gRPCServer must implement the generated protobuf service by resolving or creating the backing Database instance and dispatching each RPC to the matching Database method, marshalling requests into SDK types and responses back into protobuf, and it must also answer the Version RPC with the logical version reply."
- added `r.marshalling` (MUST): "Conversion between SDK structs and protobuf messages must be done by dedicated marshalling code so that the client and server share one definition of each field mapping, including username metadata, credential types and the per-change update descriptors."
- added `r.metrics-middleware` (SHOULD): "A metrics middleware must wrap any Database and record a measurement around each of PluginVersion, Initialize, NewUser, UpdateUser, DeleteUser, Type and Close, keyed by the database type so metrics are attributable to the backend."
- added `r.plugin-client` (MUST): "NewPluginClient must resolve the runner from the RunnerUtil and PluginClientConfig, dispense the database plugin through go-plugin, and return a Database backed by the gRPC client, wrapping it so that the returned DatabasePluginClient also reports PluginVersion and closes the underlying plugin process on Close."
- added `r.plugin-factory` (MUST): "PluginFactory and PluginFactoryVersion must look up the named plugin (optionally at a requested version) through the LookRunnerUtil, log through the supplied logger, and return a Database, so the caller never has to touch go-plugin directly."
- added `r.request-response-types` (MUST): "The interface must be expressed with the plain Go types rather than protobuf types: InitializeRequest/InitializeResponse, NewUserRequest/NewUserResponse, UpdateUserRequest/UpdateUserResponse and DeleteUserRequest/DeleteUserResponse, with UpdateUser carrying the ChangePublicKey, ChangePassword and ChangeExpiration change descriptors and Statements carrying the per-role SQL statements."
- added `r.round-trip-tests` (SHOULD): "The client, server and middleware must each carry tests that exercise the request/response round trip and the middleware wrapping, so a change to the marshalling or the interface is caught against both the client and server halves."
- added `r.serve-entrypoints` (MUST): "Serve and ServeConfig must build the go-plugin serve configuration for a single Database implementation, and ServeMultiplex and ServeConfigMultiplex must do the same for a Factory, so a plugin binary can start either a single backend or a multiplexed set of backends."
- added `r.tracing-middleware` (SHOULD): "A tracing middleware must wrap any Database and start and finish a span for each of PluginVersion, Initialize, NewUser, UpdateUser, DeleteUser, Type and Close, so that every plugin call appears in the trace."

### third-party-openbao-sdk-database-dbplugin-v5-proto

- intent: "" -> "This context exists because the deno-kcp repository vendors the OpenBao database plugin SDK, and the v5 proto package is the wire contract between a secrets engine and an out-of-process database plugin. It is generated code: protoc-gen-go and protoc-gen-go-grpc produced it from the database.proto schema, so nobody edits it by hand and it must stay byte-for-byte faithful to the upstream OpenBao release it was cut from. Its purpose is to let the rest of the repository speak the v5 plugin RPC without importing the SDK implementation, to keep the credential request and response shapes stable for any plugin binary built against v5, and to give both sides of the gRPC transport the client stubs, server interface, registration helper and unimplemented-server stub they need to interoperate."
- added `r.credential-change-statements` (MUST): "Each credential change sub-message must pair its new value with the Statements to run: ChangePassword holds NewPassword and Statements, ChangePublicKey holds NewPublicKey bytes and Statements, and ChangeExpiration holds NewExpiration and Statements."
- added `r.database-client-interface` (MUST): "DatabaseClient must be the caller-side contract and expose exactly the six RPC methods Initialize, NewUser, UpdateUser, DeleteUser, Type and Close, each taking a context, its request message and variadic grpc.CallOption and returning the matching response message with an error."
- added `r.database-server-interface` (MUST): "DatabaseServer must be the implementation-side contract and expose the same six operations Initialize, NewUser, UpdateUser, DeleteUser, Type and Close, each taking a context and the request message and returning the response message with an error."
- added `r.delete-user-request-shape` (MUST): "DeleteUserRequest must carry the username to remove and the Statements that perform the removal, and DeleteUserResponse must be an empty message."
- added `r.descriptor-index` (MUST): "Each message type must expose Descriptor returning the raw gzipped file descriptor bytes together with the index path that locates the message inside that descriptor, so reflection can resolve the message without a registry lookup."
- added `r.generated-code-boundary` (MUST): "Both files must stay machine-generated and unedited: the message file must declare the protobuf package and Go import path the generator emitted, and the gRPC file must declare the supported protoc-gen-go-grpc version, so regenerating from the upstream proto reproduces the same content."
- added `r.initialize-exchange` (MUST): "InitializeRequest must carry the plugin configuration as a structpb.Struct in ConfigData plus a VerifyConnection boolean, and InitializeResponse must return the resulting configuration as ConfigData, so a plugin knows whether to open a real connection during initialization."
- added `r.new-database-client` (MUST): "NewDatabaseClient must wrap any grpc.ClientConnInterface in an unexported databaseClient whose methods invoke the corresponding service procedure and unmarshal the reply into the response message."
- added `r.new-user-request-shape` (MUST): "NewUserRequest must describe the credential to mint: a UsernameConfig, a password string, an expiration timestamp, the creation and rollback Statements, a credential type as int32, the public key bytes and the subject string; NewUserResponse must return the generated username."
- added `r.nil-safe-getters` (MUST): "Every field getter must tolerate a nil receiver and return the field's zero value in that case, so callers can read optional nested messages such as a request's Statements, UsernameConfig or ChangePassword without a prior nil check."
- added `r.protobuf-message-contract` (MUST): "Every message type in the package must satisfy proto.Message: it must implement Reset to clear the receiver to its zero value, String to render the prototext form via protoimpl.MessageStringOf, ProtoMessage as the legacy marker, and ProtoReflect to return the protoreflect.Message view backed by the package message state."
- added `r.server-registration` (MUST): "RegisterDatabaseServer must register the database service implementation and its service descriptor with the supplied grpc.ServiceRegistrar, which makes the six methods reachable over the wire."
- added `r.statements-command-list` (MUST): "Statements must carry an ordered list of SQL command strings, so a plugin executes them in the order the engine supplied."
- added `r.type-and-empty` (MUST): "TypeResponse must report the plugin's type as a string, and the Empty message must serve as the request and the response of the argument-less Type and Close calls."
- added `r.unimplemented-server-stub` (MUST): "UnimplementedDatabaseServer must provide a stub implementation of all six service methods so a server can embed it and stay compiling when the service gains methods, and each stub must return an error rather than silently succeed."
- added `r.unsafe-server-marker` (MAY): "UnsafeDatabaseServer may be implemented by a server that knowingly accepts the forward-compatibility risk, so future service methods cannot break its build; such a server must then be passed to RegisterDatabaseServer as a DatabaseServer."
- added `r.update-user-deltas` (MUST): "UpdateUserRequest must identify the account by username and carry each change as its own optional sub-message — ChangePassword, ChangeExpiration or ChangePublicKey — alongside the credential type, so a caller can change one aspect without restating the others; UpdateUserResponse is empty."
- added `r.username-config-parts` (MUST): "UsernameConfig must carry a DisplayName and a RoleName so a secrets engine can render a human-readable name while the plugin derives the actual account name from the role."

### third-party-openbao-sdk-database-dbplugin-v5-testing

- intent: "" -> "The package exists so that every database plugin implementation under the OpenBao SDK can be tested with one consistent set of assertions instead of each plugin test file repeating the same call, error check and response validation. It centralises the retry behaviour needed on slow CI runners, the per-request timeout policy, and the fatal-error reporting used across plugin test suites, keeping the plugin tests themselves down to request construction and probe logic."
- added `r.circleci-retry` (MUST): "AssertInitializeCircleCiTest calls verifyInitialize at most five times, reports each failed attempt with t.Errorf, waits one second before the next attempt, logs when initialization succeeded on a later attempt, and returns the last response it obtained."
- added `r.close-assertion` (MUST): "AssertClose provides the package's close assertion for a dbplugin.Database, reporting any close failure through the supplied *testing.T and returning nothing."
- added `r.helper-marking` (MUST): "Each assertion helper calls t.Helper before doing work, so a reported failure points at the calling test rather than at the helper body."
- added `r.initialize-fatal` (MUST): "AssertInitialize calls verifyInitialize once and, on error, stops the test with t.Fatalf carrying the initialization error, otherwise returns the successful response."
- added `r.new-user-username-check` (MUST): "AssertNewUser stops the test with t.Fatalf when Database.NewUser returns an error, and separately fails when the response carries an empty Username, returning the response only when a username is present."
- added `r.request-timeout-resolution` (MUST): "The request timeout helper reads BAO_TEST_DATABASE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT, returns ten seconds when the variable is empty, parses a supplied value as a duration in seconds, and stops the test with t.Fatalf when that value does not parse."
- added `r.update-delete-fatal` (MUST): "AssertUpdateUser and AssertDeleteUser discard the Database response value, and stop the test with t.Fatalf on error; the delete helper includes the requested username in its failure message."
- added `r.user-request-deadline` (MUST): "AssertNewUser, AssertUpdateUser and AssertDeleteUser each build a context with the timeout helper's duration, defer its cancel function, and pass that context to the corresponding Database method, so no user operation can block the test indefinitely."

### third-party-openbao-sdk-database-helper-connutil

- intent: "" -> "This context exists because the builtin database plugins (for example the MySQL and Valkey producers under third_party/openbao/internal/builtin/database) embed connutil.SQLConnectionProducer and are driven through the connutil.ConnectionProducer interface, so the interface contract and the shared SQL producer behaviour must be described as one unit: the interface fixes what a producer can do, and sql.go fixes the default implementation of that contract, including credential escaping and connection-pool settings that every SQL-backed plugin inherits."
- added `r.close-clears-handle` (MUST): "Close must take the write lock, close the underlying *sql.DB when present, set the handle to nil, and return nil so a closed producer can be reinitialized."
- added `r.connection-reuse-and-open` (MUST): "Connection must return the cached *sql.DB when its PingContext succeeds, close and discard it when the ping fails, then open a new handle whose driver name is sqlserver for Type "mssql" and Type otherwise, appending timezone=UTC and application_name=vault for postgres:// and postgresql:// URLs, and apply max open connections, max idle connections and max connection lifetime to the handle."
- added `r.credential-escaping-tests` (SHOULD): "The package tests should cover round-tripping credentials containing braces, colons, slashes, at-signs and quotes through Init into a parseable URL, honour and reject raw credentials according to disable_escaping, and assert that template variables in credentials produce the documented template error."
- added `r.init-decodes-config` (MUST): "SQLConnectionProducer.Init must hold the mutex, store the raw config map, and weakly decode it into the producer fields; it must reject an empty connection_url, default max_open_connections to 4, default max_idle_connections to max_open_connections capped at that value, default max_connection_lifetime to "0s", and return an error wrapping "invalid max_connection_lifetime" when the duration cannot be parsed."
- added `r.init-escapes-credentials` (MUST): "Init must path-escape the username unless disable_escaping is true, path-escape the password unless disable_escaping is true or the producer Type is mysql, and substitute both values for the {{username}} and {{password}} markers in the connection URL through dbutil.QueryHelper."
